goal: 提供 8 个固定审核样本、留出集和可导入真实结果的评估基准。

interface_contracts.name: benchmark
interface_contracts.definition: CLI benchmark subcommand from T13 lazily calls cli.benchmark.main(argv:list[str])->int. Fixed 8 cases with known defects/clean/unilateral, development and held-out sets. Evaluate imported per-mode results for codex-only, claude-only, dual, official-plugin baseline; dedup verified finding matches, missed, false positives, duration and reported usage. Never fabricate real model findings/latency/usage or call models automatically. Oracle/held-out答案只供评分器读取，不放入冻结快照、prompt或审核cwd。四模式同样可见输入哈希，记录prompt模板版本。 T13仅先交付审核入口；本卡顺序扩展main添加benchmark子命令，调用本模块main，避免前置提交暴露尚未实现命令。

interface_contracts.name: benchmark evidence and closeout
interface_contracts.definition: prepare生成8个临时外部Git仓库/冻结输入，oracle不进入可见输入。template各模式not_run；score导入reports+人工judgments(source=user_supplied)，有效发现需人工认定与引用核对；issue_id语义去重，未知缺失为null/pending，不得以位置匹配冒充真实有效性。development6/heldout2。四模式共用同一manifest的snapshot/hash/promptversion。PROJECT_PLAN更新当前offline CLI与基准工具完成记录，明确真实模型基准未运行且阶段仍为1。

interface_contracts.name: human judgment binding
interface_contracts.definition: 人工judgment必须绑定case/mode/seat/finding_id加snapshot_id和整份规范化validate_report结果的report_sha256；score严格核对，防重跑复用同finding ID使旧人工判定污染新报告。未判定输出给绑定字段方便人工填写，但不生成判断或有效性结论。
